spans.s:
The affix घञ् comes after the root सी 'to lie down' when the prepositions वि and उप are in composition with it and when the sense of the word so formed is that of 'regular succession'.

Terms: घञ्

The affix अण् comes after the words व्युष्ट etc. in the Locative -7th case in construction, the sense of 'being given therein or done therein'.

Terms: अण्
